question: Whether previously observed same-work slow small-batch tail coincides with observable main-driver CPU frequency or cgroup throttling/pressure changes.
primary_metrics: fixed native-matched tail after last >32 scheduled requests
1Hz main-driver CPU frequency/context switches and cgroup counter deltas
decision_rule: One pair only. Correlated evidence can motivate one process-local controlled test, not establish causality. If differences do not recur, fields are unavailable, or counters do not distinguish slow intervals, do not automatically repeat or tune; preserve unresolved timing and suspend whole-service superiority claims.
limits: No newselector, no process affinity/priority/clock or cgroup changes. Same Host actions and native resources. CPU snapshot frequency may lag/migrate; cgroup counters cover the container and do not expose every ancestor. CPU includes CUDA polling. No timing correction or SLO threshold selection.
